title: Great app to give you an overview
text:
I’m not a network professional.  Rather, I’m a person that has been around computers, networks, group collaboration since its very beginning in the 1980’s 

People who know me are always asking for help. 

Network Analyzer is a great app to give you an overview of the network and its configuration. It solves so many of the basic problems that happen on smaller networks that aren't actively monitored. 

I can sollve simple problems by combining my basic knowledge with the facts supplied by the app.

title: iOS security handicaps
text: The iOS security changes effectively remove the valuable features that made this app worthwhile.  The awareness of other active networks near me, manufacturers of hardware, MAC addresses etc was extremely helpful to triage and troubleshoot wireless issues when helping customers.  Now, it's basically a router login page.  This is unfortunate because it's not the developer's fault but the premium version now lacks premium features.

title: Ha perso la sua utilità …
text:
… non potendo più leggere il MAC ADDRESS dei devices connessi !!
Non potendo più (dopo iOS 11) memorizzare in modo univoco e permanente il nome dei devices connessi nella lista dei dispositivi trovati non si capisce più se sulla rete sono presenti “friends or foes” !!
Capisco che non è un problema dello Sviluppatore, ma una nuova policy imposta da Apple, ma comunque sapere il solo IP ADDRESS dei devices connessi serve a poco per capire se ci sono connessioni esterne non autorizzate alla propria rete domestica … funzione che era molto utile nelle precedenti versioni di iOS.
PECCATO !!
